title: Premadesam
overview: Arjun falls in love with Aadhya, his junior in college. Though both of them like each other, they never express themselves. Madhumathi, Arjun’s mother, in a way, plays cupid. In another parallel track, Shiva, married to Maya, longs for her love and affection, rooting for her to recover from a traumatic past with Rishi. These parallel stories are intertwined with one Incident! Did that incident cleared their problems or created more difficulties?
